name: pipeline
description: Plan, review and implement features: the feature pipeline sized to the change, the review command (its wave, verification and ranking run as a workflow) and the bug-fix command, the test-value rubric for what a test is for and the tighten-tests command that prunes a suite by it, pipeline-decide for an optional decision model, pipeline-progress for the record a stopped feature run is resumed from, pipeline-suite for a suite's census and the account of what left it, the devils-advocate plan reviewer, the fresh-context code-reviewer, the finding-verifier that judges each review finding, the test-judge that judges and defends tests, the feature-contract-writer and feature-implementer agents, and an eval harness that regression-tests those agents.
